turns.q: Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
turns.replyTail:
12:08
Willow

Yes—orders can usually be cancelled if they’re still in a cancellable state (before preparation or dispatch). The time window is short and depends on the product and delivery date, because many orders move to preparation quickly. Once an order is being prepared, dispatched, or out for delivery, cancellation isn’t possible.

If you’d like me to check your specific order’s status and try to cancel it if eligible, please share:

How do I update my contact or account details?
12:10
Willow

You can update most contact and account details in your account. Here’s how:

Log in to your Bloom & Wild account (website or app)
Go to My Account
Profile: update your name, email address, and phone number (if you change your email, we’ll send a verification link)
Address Book: add/edit delivery and billing addresses and set a default address
Payment Methods: update or remove saved cards
Communication Preferences: manage marketing emails and notifications
Save your changes

Helpful notes:

Updates to your account won’t change details on orders you’ve already placed. If you need changes to an existing order, I can check whether it’s still cancellable so you can place a new order with the correct details. Just share your order number and postcode.
If you’re locked out or need help changing the account email you can no longer access, let me know and I’ll guide you.
